notes.title: v[1.019] Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thank you so much for your feedback and support.
Here are the new features, improvements, and some fixes:

[b][h3]1) New Building: Transfer Center[/h3][/b]
Transfer Center is a building where you can request extra penguins for your settlement and also send your penguins to the other settlements in the kingdom.
If you send your penguins, you get temporary reputation points.
If you request penguins, you get temporary penalty reputation points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/31b4265083d7a46ad5fef3a7f1e0755d957bd310.jpg[/img]

Buildings Menu > Technology & Defense > Transfer Center

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/f2c78db11368edd02ba0ad9f525a5a8ad6b8302e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/195c1377a0dd8511bab6efb21bb6497f84072ae0.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]2) More Penguins at the Start[/h3][/b]
Relax Mode -> 15 penguins
Normal difficulty -> 13 penguins
Hard difficulty -> 10 penguins
Survival difficulty ->  8 penguins
One more penguin for all difficulty options is added to the start of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/aa6458abc1b153470578815e3098f10bc99064cb.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/86d62292e343931aa57cc35074e4a920b7ed61dd.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]3) Fewer Thief Seals[/h3][/b]
The total amount of thief seals in a seal group is decreased.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/8da3b4509a86462ea2f6c45fce73759b59f4ea67.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]4) Bar Progress Speed[/h3][/b]
Extra information about the fun and spirituality buildings is added.
This number can be used to understand which building fills the fun/spirituality bar faster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/30742482efcb36853b5bcb7b55202b176248aab6.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]5) Defense Towers Specs[/h3][/b]
Attack power information is added to the defense towers.
(Defense against killer whales and thief seals)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/b4afe87eba8a8497166721e0c0d4b538235af6b3.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]6) Arrows - Tutorials[/h3][/b]
More noticeable arrows are added to the tutorials.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/0240a8dd925a1018913d84753366dd1df73582a8.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/abe8c7b945e7c8e6735fda8be8eb04d96d59092e.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]7) Decoration Interaction Area[/h3][/b]
Circles of the decorations' ranges are redesigned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/27202bb91343d24ae78c03c76860c0623a303e66.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]8) Remove a Penguin from the Current Job[/h3][/b]
You can remove a penguin from the current job on the penguin widget.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/1b2f1742ce6c8e06840bcc8fd79f679d443c0fb9.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]9) Menu UI Redesigned[/h3][/b]
Reputation Menu, Badge Menu, Profile Menu, Science Menu, and Help Menu are redesigned

Reputation Menu
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/bf94e8d10be6f581033267f940036ff95fbd3e16.jpg[/img]

Badge Menu
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/cc20b9bcf2486f59eeb54cfb9996560b2e8550ca.jpg[/img]

Profile Menu
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/094a93c4926b4905535418d63594da569c5c544e.jpg[/img]

Science Menu
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/2f52524c2705d3fff33b4d17c46e9e326c69ba31.jpg[/img]


[b][h3]10) Kids House and Kids Villa - Capacity Increased[/h3][/b]
The capacity of the Kids House and Kids Villa are increased.
Five child penguins can live in a Kids House now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/80213e8723bcc95de8e6a475c7be6e2d0439b112.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]11) New Building Widgets[/h3][/b]
The building widgets are redesigned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/954d67c91e94c449ef67b2959405f6615efbad2a.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]12) Building SFX[/h3][/b]
Building-click sounds are added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/9826f022b55b56399b19492932d476c235487a9a.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]13) Save & Load Game Menu[/h3][/b]
Save & Load Game Menu is redesigned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/f33c57b109b7443bdfbe0590bf89e518648a3f17.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]14) Resolutions[/h3][/b]
Resolution issue is fixed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/00cd292c776e38d3d562782403e5d83bc7cdf5c9.jpg[/img]



Please let us know about your feedback and suggestions.
We'll continue to update the game based on your feedback.

All the best
Turquoise Revival Games

notes.title: v[1.018] Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thank you so much for your feedback and support.
Here are the new features, improvements, and some fixes:

[b][h3]1) No Worker[/h3][/b]
"No worker assigned" widget has a new look.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/ef9bb4f72a85415d908d9d4f729b3f8dcf2f5c0a.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]2) Newcomer Ramp - After a Failed Attack[/h3][/b]
If a killer whale attacks the Newcomer Ramp but is not destroyed, the Newcomer Ramp keeps the previous remaining time for new penguins' arrival.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/f17904c281fae93acfb738fce9f4568e6f8ec7b6.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]3) Homeless Penguins[/h3][/b]
"Homeless penguins" warning widget on HUD's bottom center is redesigned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/581e0d7747765fb93aaf5aa23140d457305915be.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]4) New HUD Design[/h3][/b]
HUD's top center has a new look. Categories (food/medicine/materials) are separated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/3570cea2cbf69c20614550e902a2f33b35715300.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]5) Buildings Menu[/h3][/b]
The Buildings Menu has a new look.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/94b44b3eb8583296638422131441e7725f7c0254.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]6) Main Menu Design[/h3][/b]
Main Menu, Options, and Pause Menu are redesigned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/45bafaf67dfb91966e23f16dc6acf44890030603.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]7) New Profile[/h3][/b]
New Profile creation section is redesigned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/97859d3dfa69385d67d5c520876d92fe3461a3e9.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]8) Defense Tower Circle[/h3][/b]
Circles of the defense towers are redesigned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/e2eb1e254ce0dfee1da5804d9f5fc751ed8387ec.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]9) New Adult Penguin Image[/h3][/b]
The adult penguin image on HUD is redesigned. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/fa534d635ab63ea95dd37727249d458c196409a7.jpg[/img]

Please let us know about your feedback and suggestions.
We'll continue to update the game based on your feedback.

All the best
Turquoise Revival Games

notes.title: v[1.011] Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thank you so much for your feedback and support.
Here are the new features, improvements, and some fixes:

[b][h3]1) New Language: Korean[/h3][/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/e8990530bfbc4d00b7f50dbc37ef1b6567ab44e2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/6188faa09e4e581021cd389126af98fd5d7038ad.png[/img][/url]

[b][h3]2) Font Size Increased[/h3][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/64ee36538f802e405fc1828b6fd12fec56103e65.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/87428bbd513b50c08e79ea013ec83e65f82c8d2a.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]3) New Building: Stone Extractor[/h3][/b]
(This building can be unlocked in the full game)
Stone Extractor extracts stones from the bottom of the ocean.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/56c6b0aa11bd12bb44988d0202d37683a41252b5.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]4) More Penguins at the Start[/h3][/b]
Two more penguins for Relax Mode and Normal Mode and one penguin for Hard and Survival Mode are added to the start of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/94e233ef236dda1ee928fed07f28d64b8c2a2408.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]5) Ice Spear Production[/h3][/b]
Ice Spear Tower produces two ice spears from one snow block.
Ice Spear Tower limit by default is increased to 14.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/8eff5e542ed9f46665e33049532dc6b66b9cfca4.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]6) Killer Whale Difficulty Setting[/h3][/b]
This setting affects the visit frequencies of killer whales and their total health.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/ed6b9ff3c86551f65603d59555758ffaa73aa469.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]7) Thief Seals Difficulty Setting[/h3][/b]
This setting affects the total health and amount of thief seals visiting your settlement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/db15325d2e9740be247f0e0f65ef788552212120.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]8) Productivity Widget[/h3][/b]
The productivity widget on top of the building is redesigned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/e1cf509e54a00e30bc6313da40834f93b54d1ebc.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]9) Task Unlock Type (Science Points)[/h3][/b]
Required science points can be seen on the task widget.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/69f59a1d4c7e26037153ee68fe573bf1dc4b6152.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]10) Assign Worker[/h3][/b]
Assign worker hover info is fixed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/abca8fc42ff3926365c502586ca0daa07f9809a1.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]11) Ocean Garbage Collector[/h3][/b]
The particle location of the building is fixed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/69882060654cf25a93a86c52ffa98231902fd7b4.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]12) Penguin Productivity[/h3][/b]
Penguin productivity percentage can always be seen on worker widgets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/184a8d359bbdad152000d4da4526b21e63997654.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]13) New Loading Screen[/h3][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/7c53938ec247b1fff88ff082728432c87ffba57e.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]14) Annual Objectives[/h3][/b]
This feature is for the full version of the game. Annual objectives are received at the end of the year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/0695915b7ad9ffbecdaee4900b0de44f1aedd3f0.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]15) Settlement Level Icon[/h3][/b]
The current settlement level icon is shown on the HUD-Profile Menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/55e0644294565d1d0587932d9a3102d26c12c66a.jpg[/img]

[u]Other fixes and improvements:[/u]
* Fixed some translations 
* Fixed the help request widget - game paused
* Fixed the "All penguins died" situation - New penguins join your settlement if all your penguins die.

Older Savegames are not compatible with this version.

Please let us know about your feedback and suggestions.
We'll continue to update the game based on your feedback.

All the best
Turquoise Revival Games

notes.title: v[1.007] Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thank you so much for your feedback and support.
Here are the new features, improvements, and some fixes:

[b][h3]1) New Languages: French - Czech - Thai[/h3][/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/a33a01e7b4b900bc20e97e8b1dbb8769004b17af.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/f8085a5bf101cb3abb770b8b30a3849055deb89b.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/fa33729f20d35cdcd6d6d62bceb798a2f9480ea2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/2e2804d74583b0b8d2580c8792665422e7d3be3f.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/8dbc53093c308b78222e9dd488c2f812fe5ced3a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/5c4b2bed01303aeddffaf6e5d6ea6de96068f2e8.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Korean is coming soon.[/h3]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/e8990530bfbc4d00b7f50dbc37ef1b6567ab44e2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/6188faa09e4e581021cd389126af98fd5d7038ad.png[/img][/url]

[b][h3]2) Produced Amount Widget[/h3][/b]
A new popup widget shows up on top of the production buildings when enough amount is produced to move to the related storage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/d202c4af9cb3b24d879c9a1ccec3d5b01470663e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/afdec73e8d35be6c6b63e7db44579beda91d7a10.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]3) Remaining Time to Become an Adult[/h3][/b]
When you click on a child penguin, you can see the remaining time to become an adult penguin. We made it more visible with the help of moving arrows.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/e8a7dbd452e78db1193eec2d622d8fac3b4ac480.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]4) UI Design Improvements[/h3][/b]
Building warning widgets, game-speed buttons, pause widget, help button, and pause menu button are redesigned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/ca31b6a1870acf25217b2624cb2b65b7d745538e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/5c4d64e1e3b12e048116a0cd97928461cd375d0e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753179/d5890c377dfed74f1bc2ee9f1cd455ff06401add.jpg[/img]

[u]Other fixes and improvements:[/u]
*Fixed some translations
*Fixed the unending huddle-up issue (Newcomers are coming during the huddle-up ceremony)
*Fixed Defense Tower waiting material issue

Please let us know about your feedback and suggestions.
We'll continue to update the game based on your feedback.


All the best
Turquoise Revival Games
